description: This Java class defines the entity 'SystemNotification' used in a sales management system. It models a notification with properties such as key, value, associated merchant store, user, start/end dates, and audit information, and it maps to a database table with JPA annotations.

classes.name: SystemNotification
classes.description: An entity representing system notifications associated with merchants and users, including scheduling and audit information.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with this notification.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this notification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key of the notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key of the notification.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the configuration key for this notification.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the configuration key for this notification.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value/message of the notification.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value/message of the notification.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for the notification.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the notification.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the notification.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the notification.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the notification.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this notification.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the notification.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a user with this notification.
